targets.review_note: Text specifies one starting cell and growth into edge-adjacent empty cells. Reachable nonempty occupied sets are exactly connected vertex subsets: each connected subset has a rooted spanning-tree growth order. Thus maximize the weight of a nonempty connected subset, allowing negative connectors. A row-major frontier tracks connected components with canonical labels. Taking a cell joins its upper and left components; skipping a cell may remove the final frontier occurrence of a component. If other components remain that state is impossible; otherwise the connected shape is completed and no further selected cells are allowed. Keep the best weight per frontier and best completed score, excluding the never-started empty state from final acceptance. This enumerates connectivity without assuming a rectangle or positive-only cells. The image is just a growth example; all adjacency and objective information is textual.
